page.layout: One text column of Latin and Arabic notes, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head "NOTÆ." above the text, page number 67 at top right. Signature "K 3" and catchword "facti" at the foot.

main_text.p: Abrash dictus لبرص كان لـــه scil. ob Lepram quæ ipsi inerat: unde [?] الابـرص dicendus fuerat, quod ipsi nomen imponere veriti Arabes الابرش dixerunt, quod mollius quid sonare videtur, ic.[?] maculis aspersum, ita AlFirauzabadius. Hic est cujus & in proverbio mentio كدماني جذيمة i.e. Infstar daorum Jodaimæ compotatarum. Primus idem ex Arabum Regibus qui sibi المجنيق i.e. Machinam bellicam seu Ballistam confecit, primus cuiمن رفع [?] cerei præferebantur, primus qu جذيمة له البغال † Aljannab. & Scholiast. referentibus AlJannabio, Ahmede, Josephi filio. & Scholiaste in Ebn Abdun. Bellum cum Amro quodam Amalekita, qui Mesopotamia imperavit gessit, eumq; è medio sustulit. ipse deinde à زبا Zoba, Amri filia, cujus amore irretitus fuerat, astu interfectus periit.
Qui sequuntur Reges واللخميون Lachmienses, seu Lachmidæ audiunt; è posteris scil [?] لخم بن عمرو بن هبا Lachmi f. Amri. f. Sabæ. dicuntur & المناذر Mondari, & آل المنذر Familia Mondari.

4 عمرو بن عدي Amrus Adi filius è رقاش Rakash Jodaimæ sorore, qui avunculi sui cædem ut ulcisceretur, dolo قصير Kosairi cujusdam, qui Jodaimæ servus fuerat, obtinuit. Hoc pacto. Præcisi Kosairo volenti nares, & tergum flagellis laniatum, quo melius se in gratiam Zobæ, quasi Amro, à quo tam indigne tractatus fuerat, summopere infensus, insinuaret, atque ita opportunitatem nactus vindi-ctam de ea sumeret. Quod & fecit, mercium (quibus importandis à Zoba, quæ fidem ipsi adhibuerat, præfectus est) prætextu, hominibus armatis quos cistis incluserat, in ipsius arcem, introductis: cujus

page.notes: Right margin: three Arabic notes beside the text (one marked *, one marked †, and one unmarked at the lower part of the margin, near "Lachmi"). Their Arabic is only partly legible and is given as best read. Dagger note reads "Aljannab. & Scholiast." The Arabic in the text, notably the proper names and the words after "Zoba" and "Lachmi", is doubtful and should be checked against the scan. Abbreviation "ic." in "ic. maculis" is uncertain. The line "primus qu" is printed as such and seems broken. Catchword "facti" is the first word of the next page.
